mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.SCM_COM_SYS_LOG (SYS_LOG_ID, LOG_TP_CD, SYS_LOG_MSG_CTN, CALL_PGM_URL, RQR_CLNT_IP, MNU_ID, SHT_NM, MNU_BTN_CD, EXCT_MSG_CTN, LOG_ST_DTM, TRNM_ST_DTM, DB_TRNM_ST_DTM, DB_TRNM_END_DTM, TRNM_END_DTM, LOG_END_DTM, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE) VALUES(#{traceId}, #{typeCd} , #{params}, #{requestUrl}, #{clientIp}, #{menuId}, #{shtNm}, #{buttonCd}, SUBSTRB(#{exception}, 1, 4000), #{clientStTm}, #{serverStTm}, #{sqlStTm}, #{sqlEdTm}, #{serverEdTm}, #{clientEdTm}, #{userId}, SYSDATE , #{userId}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE SCM_MGR.SCM_COM_SYS_LOG SET LOG_END_DTM = SYSTIMESTAMP, LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE SYS_LOG_ID = #{traceId}
mapper.select: SELECT T.MNU_ID, NVL(MSG_MNU.MSG_NM, MNU.MNU_DESC) AS MNU_NM , T.LOG_TP_CD, NVL(MSG_TP.MSG_NM, LOOK.SEGMENT3) AS LOG_TP_NM , T.MNU_BTN_CD, NVL(MSG_BTN.MSG_NM, BTN.API_MSG_DESC) AS MNU_BTN_NM , T.DIFF_TOTAL, T.DIFF_TOTAL-T.DIFF_SVR AS DIFF_NET , T.DIFF_SVR-T.DIFF_DB AS DIFF_SVR, T.DIFF_DB , T.RQR_CLNT_IP, T.EXCT_MSG_CTN , T.CREATED_BY AS USER_ID FROM (SELECT TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(DB_TRNM_END_DTM, 'SSSSS.FF3')) * 1000 - TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(DB_TRNM_ST_DTM, 'SSSSS.FF3')) * 1000 AS DIFF_DB , TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TRNM_END_DTM, 'SSSSS.FF3')) * 1000 - TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TRNM_ST_DTM, 'SSSSS.FF3')) * 1000 AS DIFF_SVR , TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LOG_END_DTM, 'SSSSS.FF3')) * 1000 - TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LOG_ST_DTM, 'SSSSS.FF3')) * 1000 AS DIFF_TOTAL , TT.* FROM SCM_COM_SYS_LOG TT) T JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LOOK ON T.LOG_TP_CD = LOOK.SEGMENT1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT BTN.MNU_ID, BTN.SHT_NM, BTN.MNU_BTN_CD, API.API_MSG_ID, API.API_MSG_DESC FROM SCM_ADM_MNU_BTN_MPG_M BTN JOIN SCM_ADM_API_M API ON BTN.API_ID = API.API_ID ) BTN ON T.MNU_ID = BTN.MNU_ID AND T.SHT_NM = BTN.SHT_NM AND T.MNU_BTN_CD = BTN.MNU_BTN_CD LEFT JOIN SCM_ADM_MNU_M MNU ON T.MNU_ID = MNU.MNU_ID LEFT JOIN SCM_ADM_MSG_M MSG_MNU ON MNU.MNU_MSG_ID = MSG_MNU.MSG_ID AND MSG_MNU.LANG_CD = #{langCd} LEFT JOIN SCM_ADM_MSG_M MSG_TP ON LOOK.SEGMENT2 = MSG_TP.MSG_ID AND MSG_TP.LANG_CD = #{langCd} LEFT JOIN SCM_ADM_MSG_M MSG_BTN ON BTN.API_MSG_ID = MSG_BTN.MSG_ID AND MSG_TP.LANG_CD = #{langCd} WHERE 1=1 AND LOOK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'LOG_TP_CD' ORDER BY T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC
